name: ✨Collect The Body
desc:
Welcome to Collect The Body!

⭐ Find all your body parts around a map!
🦴 Try out another player's body parts on yourself! 
✨ Once you collected your body, go to the big yellow beam at the center of map and earn +1 Score!

Happy exploring!
